label: broad_tumor_compatible
rationale: Dose escalation explicitly uses a non-exhaustive solid-tumor list with sponsor approval for unlisted malignancies; other-solid-tumor expansion uses open examples. Undefined 'EMC' is not taken as an explicit sarcoma diagnosis.
cohort_reconciliation: Phase I solid tumors permit unlisted malignancies only with sponsor/designee approval.
Phase II cohorts 1-3 are NSCLC without specified actionable alterations, TNBC, and HNSCC; they do not admit EMC histology.
Phase II cohort 4 uses 'e.g.' other solid tumors, including tumors with dose-escalation signals; exact EMC acceptance and phase/cohort availability require confirmation.
extra_biomarker_requirement: No additional tumor biomarker gate is stated for the general/other-solid-tumor cohorts. NSCLC negative genomic tests apply only to its cohort; required tissue in expansion is not proof of a target alteration.
protocol_uncertainty: Sponsor approval, undefined EMC abbreviation, external protocol and Laboratory Manual unavailable. Broad conditional scope is not an uncomplicated positive or enrollment permission.
quotes: The sponsor or designee must approve eligibility for malignancies other than those specifically mentioned above.

label: explicit_diagnosis_compatible
rationale: Conditions explicitly name extraskeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma within a broad NRSTS risk-adapted protocol, and the saved histologic exclusions do not include EMC. Explicit disease listing is reconciled with NRSTS eligibility rather than used alone.
cohort_reconciliation: Low-risk A/B, intermediate-risk A/B/C and high-risk groups allocate according to grade, size, resection and metastasis; some receive surgery/observation rather than systemic treatment.
CIC-DUX4 forces high-risk allocation but is not required for all high-risk entrants or for EMC. Histologic exclusions include DSRCT and BCOR-CCNB3, not EMC.
Selinexor is linked to high-risk treatment; trial-level scope does not promise every intervention to every EMC case.
extra_biomarker_requirement: No extra tumor alteration required for EMC; sequencing and homologous-repair assessments are exploratory, not established alterations.
protocol_uncertainty: External protocol and exact risk allocation unreviewed; age 1-30 at diagnostic biopsy and no prior NRSTS systemic therapy are substantial limits. Some arm descriptions and intervention lists differ about radiation after complete resection; individual regimen is unestablished.
quotes: Patients must be 1-30 years at the time of the biopsy that established the diagnosis of NRSTS.

label: insufficient_evidence
rationale: BCX17725 is studied in healthy participants and Netherton syndrome, with no tumor-scope evidence; a healthy-volunteer flag cannot establish EMC eligibility or a universal cancer exclusion.
cohort_reconciliation: Parts 1/2 are healthy-adult dose escalation with placebo; parts 3/4 are open-label Netherton cohorts, including adolescents in part 4.
extra_biomarker_requirement: Netherton diagnosis is required in disease cohorts; no tumor fusion route.
protocol_uncertainty: Only key inclusion criteria are saved; exclusion criteria absent and external protocol unreviewed.
quotes: Confirmed diagnosis of Netherton syndrome (Parts 3 and 4)

label: explicit_exclusion
rationale: EMC is explicitly named in the excluded histologies, overriding the opening NRSTS inclusion category.
cohort_reconciliation: Part 1 osteosarcoma/Ewing/RMS/NRSTS cohorts and Part 2 expansion remain under shared exclusions; no EMC rescue arm is described.
extra_biomarker_requirement: No molecular gate overrides exclusion; universal-donor NK cells are an intervention, not EMC biomarker evidence.
protocol_uncertainty: External protocol unreviewed. Exclusion preamble specifies intermediate/grade 2 or 3 tumors; grade-related scope should be confirmed rather than extrapolated into a hypothetical permitted EMC subgroup. NK-cycle detail differs between summary and detailed schedule.
quotes: are not eligible for this study:

label: explicit_diagnosis_compatible
rationale: Eligibility explicitly lists extra-skeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma (with registry spelling) for post-resection lung surveillance. This is diagnostic surveillance, not active antitumor therapy.
cohort_reconciliation: CXR and CT arms share stage III high-risk truncal/extremity, size and R0/R1 resection requirements. Retroperitoneal/abdominal, uterine and primary bone sarcomas are excluded; this does not erase the explicit extraskeletal histology inclusion.
extra_biomarker_requirement: No additional molecular gate; EWSR1 condition terminology is not required for the explicit EMC route.
protocol_uncertainty: External protocol unreviewed; NOT_YET_RECRUITING status verified 2024-07 is not live availability. Title calls phase III while structured phase is NA. Grade and anatomical restrictions require individual assessment.
quotes: Patient must not have retroperitoneal, mesenteric/abdominal sarcoma

label: explicit_exclusion
rationale: Both Ewing histology and EWSR1-ETS translocation are required; EWSR1-NR4A3 EMC is not an ETS fusion or Ewing diagnosis.
cohort_reconciliation: Dose confirmation permits evaluable disease and dose expansion requires measurable disease, but both require the same Ewing histology/fusion. No all-FET or general-sarcoma basket.
extra_biomarker_requirement: Specific EWSR1-ETS molecular requirement belongs to Ewing scope; no EMC-compatible molecular route established.
protocol_uncertainty: External protocol unreviewed. Structured purpose is BASIC_SCIENCE although description assesses an investigational antitumor drug; both retained without recoding to TREATMENT.
quotes: Histologically or cytologically confirmed EWS with molecular evidence of an EWSR1 translocation with an E26 transformation-specific (ETS) family gene
